name: open_issue_numbers
purpose: Collect the numbers the open issues are waiting on, without the owner at the keyboard: GI and LOD cost per option (#7, #83, #10), WaterMaskSoft 0 vs 1 from above (#104), the DebugWater bit bisect (#5, #80), the emit pass cost and portal view (#9, #84), and the F10 overlay not breaking geometry (#79). Output decides which defaults the numbers support flipping. Fire, lily and cliff views are added once their fixes are on main. Also bisects the broken-character report against the three changed defaults (mod vs mod_noclamp, mod_oldpost, mod_oldao, mod_oldall).
